title: CanonicalDoc
description: The L1 canonical document model plus its L2 chunks (WP13 R1/R2): every source format resolves to this shape and nothing enters the KB except through it. Holds ANONYMIZED text only (R7) — raw parsed output lives in the pursuit workspace under its TTL, raw source bytes (L0) in the restricted store. Derivation links are build-time, not retrofit: source_hash points at L0, each chunk's element span points into L1, and each chunk's kb_id backref points at its L3 card — the backrefs are what make heading-path descent a single-file read instead of a catalog scan (R9). Deliberately clock-free: byte-identical across kill/resume.

doc_id.description: Content-addressed from the L0 bytes: cd_ + sha256(source)[:12].

source_hash.description: Full sha256 of the L0 source artifact — the L1→L0 derivation link and the identity.source_hash every derived card carries.

extractor.description: Which stack parsed this (python-docx | docling | text …) — the B57 seam identity, same vocabulary as ExtractedDoc.extractor.

extraction_fingerprint.description: stack_fingerprint() of the producing stack (C12 machinery).

extraction_status.description: degraded = the parse was imperfect; the document is STILL modeled and STILL ingested (X6). Inherited by every card minted from this model.

elements.description: The document's structure in reading order — the neutral element list both producer stacks emit into.

text.description: Anonymized. table_row = pipe-joined cells; figure = empty until a description card exists (generation rides A1); qa = 'Q: …\n\nA: …'.

page.description: Source page where provenance survives extraction (PDF); absent for DOCX/text.

chunks.description: L2: structure-aware chunks. Boundaries follow document structure; NO size cap anywhere (R4) — size is recorded on the card's chunk_span as a diagnostic, never enforced (R5).

doc_path.description: Heading path, outermost first. Navigation and provenance only (KB10) — never a retrieval key, never identity.

elements.description: [start, end) index span into elements[] — the L2→L1 derivation link.

kb_id.description: Backref to the L3 card minted from this chunk — the descent index. Absent until the card exists.
